31eLGXBg35PppF_DEJtILQ.zh: 泰國近期受持續降雨影響,自今年7月起,新增病例數高於過去5年,截至9/23累計報告3,303例確定病例、46例死亡(致死率:1.39%),受影響族群以60歲以上為主。高風險族群為頻繁接觸 土壤、水或潮濕環境之工作者。當局指出,多數死亡病例與延遲就醫有關,呼籲⺠眾勿自行服藥,並應儘速就醫。
31eLGXBg35PppF_DEJtILQ.en: Thailand has recently been affected by persistent rainfall. Since July this year, new cases have been higher than in the past five years, with 3,303 confirmed cases and 46 deaths reported as of 23 September (case fatality rate: 1.39%). Most affected people are aged 60 and over. High-risk groups are workers who frequently come into contact with soil, water or damp environments. Authorities note that most deaths were associated with delayed medical care and urge people not to self-medicate and to seek medical attention as soon as possible.

KWa4JGmWbq2uVRtozoAMYg.zh: 泰國今年截至9/16累計報告3例確定病例,其中2例死亡。自2019 年啟動監測以來,該國累計報告10例病例,其中5例死亡,病患多為50歲以上,感染途徑與飼養寵物、接觸貓狗、遭蜱蟲叮咬或徒手觸碰蜱蟲相關,由於SFTS病毒在當地犬隻動物血清陽性率達16.6%,存在廣泛天然宿主,該國已於9/18將SFTS正式列入法定傳染病強制通報,提醒⺠眾接觸動物後若出現不明原因發燒,應儘速就醫。
KWa4JGmWbq2uVRtozoAMYg.en: Thailand has reported 3 confirmed cases this year as of 16 September, 2 of which were fatal. Since surveillance began in 2019, the country has reported 10 cumulative cases, 5 of them fatal; patients are mainly over 50 years old. Transmission is associated with keeping pets, contact with cats or dogs, tick bites, or bare-handed handling of ticks. Because SFTS virus has a seropositivity rate of 16.6% in local dogs, indicating a wide natural host reservoir, Thailand formally listed SFTS as a mandatory notifiable disease on 18 September, and reminds people that if they develop unexplained fever after contact with animals they should seek medical care promptly.

GJ2pmGbe40GTkGuB9yUZ_w.zh: 泰國疫情持續上升,今年截至9/16累計報告6萬5,108例,其中1例死亡,第37週報告5,472例,病患以4歲以下為多,病患分布以素林府(Surin) 為多。
GJ2pmGbe40GTkGuB9yUZ_w.en: Thailand's epidemic continues to rise. As of 16 September this year, 65,108 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 1 death; 5,472 cases were reported in week 37. Patients are mainly under 4 years old, and cases are most concentrated in Surin Province.

_GZaZMttbdb5rHkT_udkZw.zh: 泰國今年截至9/1累計報告53,362例病例,其中住院5,408例、死亡1例,疫情低於去年同期,病患集中於0-4歲、5-9歲及10-14歲年齡層。因適逢雨季與開學季,學校與托嬰中爆發群聚疫情,當局已發布警報,呼籲學童倘發病應在家休養5天,如同一班級一週內出現2例以上個案,應停課清消1天,並於後續一週加強班級疫情監測。
_GZaZMttbdb5rHkT_udkZw.en: As of 1 September this year, Thailand has cumulatively reported 53,362 cases, of which 5,408 were hospitalised and one died. The epidemic is lower than the same period last year, with cases concentrated in the 0–4, 5–9 and 10–14 age groups. Because it coincides with the rainy season and the start of the school term, clusters have broken out in schools and infant care centres. Authorities have issued an alert advising that children who fall ill stay at home to rest for five days; if two or more cases occur in the same class within one week, the class should be suspended for one day for disinfection, and surveillance in the class should be strengthened for the following week.

RNN6rbB5tzh7Ip3eH-1Qpw.zh: 斯里蘭卡今年截至7/30累計報告84,724例病例,其中62例死亡(CFR: 0.07%),其中7月報告約2.9萬例,疫情集中於加姆珀哈區(Gampaha District),以第二型(DENV-2)血清型傳播力為高。近一週病例數雖下降3%,惟住院數仍高,當局已增加登革熱高風險告警區域。 泰國今年截至第30週(8/1)累計報告1萬7,299例病例,病患多介於10-19歲,死亡率最高的年齡層為40-49歲及60歲以上,疫情低於預測且低於去年同期。 菲律賓宿霧(Cebu)今年截至7/18累計報告1228例病例,其中10 例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加12.35%;另三寶顏市(Zamboanga)今年截至7/25累計報告1,184例,疫情較去年同期增加20%,其中11例死亡(多為10歲以下兒童)。
RNN6rbB5tzh7Ip3eH-1Qpw.en: Sri Lanka has reported 84,724 dengue cases cumulatively this year up to 30 July, including 62 deaths (CFR: 0.07%). About 29,000 cases were reported in July alone. The outbreak is concentrated in Gampaha District, where transmission of DENV-2 serotype is high. Although cases fell 3% over the past week, hospitalizations remain high, and authorities have expanded high-risk dengue alert areas. Thailand has reported 17,299 cases cumulatively this year as of week 30 (1 August), mostly among people aged 10–19 years. The highest mortality is among those aged 40–49 years and 60 years and above. Cases are below forecasts and lower than the same period last year. In the Philippines, Cebu has reported 1,228 cases cumulatively as of 18 July, including 10 deaths, a 12.35% increase over the same period last year. Zamboanga City has reported 1,184 cases cumulatively as of 25 July, a 20% increase over the same period last year, including 11 deaths, mostly among children under 10 years.

nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年6/30累計145國/地區報告18萬8,565例確定病例,其中521例死亡。 今年6月共計33國家/地區報告1,128例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:0.8%),以馬達加斯加(546例)、美國(111例)、剛果⺠主共和國(86例)、英國(46例)及葡萄牙(45例)為高,64%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年5月,美洲區及東南亞區病例數呈上升趨勢,其餘地區疫情則下降;東地中海區則無通報病例。哥斯大黎加、迦納及立陶宛通報首例Ib型病例;幾內亞比索首度通報3例IIb型病例。 非洲地區近6週(6/8-7/19)共計10國報告1,112例確定病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:1.1%),以馬達加斯加(940例)、安哥拉(57例)、肯亞(48例)、剛果⺠主共和國(30例)及喀麥隆(24例)為高。 非洲以外地區,共11國報告Ib型社區傳播;近6週報告Ib型病例最多國家為葡萄牙(60例),其次為英國(31例)、泰國(29例)、法國(18例)及西班牙(16例)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情,截至7/19,累計報告2,921例確定病例及18例死亡(CFR:0.6%)。疫情擴及全國61%行政區(70/115),主要影響15-49歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(89,723人施打第1劑),惟因檢測陽性率由65%上升至74%,以及面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流、醫療量能與風險溝通等挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。 安哥拉自今年5月中旬起疫情升溫,截至7/19累計108例確定病例及1例死亡(CFR 0.9%),主要集中於Cabinda省(佔80%),52%病例為20-29歲族群,其中女性及女童比例高達66%,當局已啟動相關防治措施。
nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.

mDCwBvftgvruRopZ_BP18g.zh: 泰國今年截至7/8累計報告1萬3,143例病例,其中19例死亡,病患以10-14歲為多,死亡個案多為⻑者或有其他共病等,病例數雖約為去(2025)年之50%,惟整體疫情仍呈上升趨勢。
mDCwBvftgvruRopZ_BP18g.en: As of 8 July this year, Thailand has reported 13,143 cases cumulatively, including 19 deaths. Patients are mostly aged 10 to 14 years, and deaths have mostly occurred among older people or those with other comorbidities. Although case numbers are about 50% of last year's, the overall outbreak continues to show an upward trend.

aSkNWGOmwhqg5ZX-hoFsbA.zh: 泰國今年截至第28週累計報告76例病例,另2023-2025年分別報告逾700例、423例及236例,疫情呈下降趨勢。
aSkNWGOmwhqg5ZX-hoFsbA.en: Thailand has reported 76 cases cumulatively this year as of week 28. Thailand reported more than 700 cases in 2023, 423 in 2024 and 236 in 2025. Case numbers show a downward trend.

FjZZYt2y_obXo1hdSlUAxQ.zh: 葉門塔伊茲省(Taiz)疫情上升,今年1至5月期間,累計逾400例人類病例,主要為兒童,迄無通報死亡病例。相較2024-2025年(分別為148、481例)疫情,顯著上升。當地疫苗與免疫球蛋白嚴重短缺,大幅限制暴露後預防(PEP)量能。 泰國羅勇府(Rayong)報告1件動物確定案例(該犬隻已死亡),3名遭咬傷⺠眾及具暴露風險之貓犬,皆已進行暴露後預防接種。當局已於羅勇府、曼谷及北欖府部分高風險地區發布臨時疫區公告,並實施為期30天的哺乳類動物移動限制。
FjZZYt2y_obXo1hdSlUAxQ.en: In Taiz Governorate, Yemen, cases are rising. From January to May this year, more than 400 human cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly among children, and no deaths have been reported so far. This is significantly higher than the cases reported in 2024 and 2025 (148 and 481 respectively). Local shortages of vaccines and immunoglobulin severely limit post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) capacity. In Rayong Province, Thailand, 1 confirmed animal case was reported (the dog has died). Three people who were bitten, and cats and dogs with exposure risk, have all received post-exposure vaccination. Authorities have issued temporary outbreak zone notices in high-risk areas of Rayong, Bangkok and Nonthaburi, and imposed a 30-day movement restriction on mammals.

jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年5/31累計144國/地區報告18萬5,882例確定病例,其中509例死亡。 今年5月共計32國家/地區報告1,142例確定病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加(649例)、中國(89例)、法國(63例)、澳洲(50例)及德國(45例)為高,63.9%的病例來自非洲地區。相較今年4月,西太平洋區及非洲區病例數呈上升趨勢 ,其餘地區疫情則下降,挪威通報首例Ib型病例,另波蘭先前的I型病例確定為Ib型次分支。 非洲地區近6週(5/4-6/14)共計10國報告790例確定病例,其中3 例死亡(CFR 0.45%),以馬達加斯加、肯亞、幾內亞、南蘇丹、喀麥隆及剛果⺠主共和國為高;非洲以外地區,為西班牙與泰國持續報告Ib型社區傳播。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月以來面臨全球最大規模的Ib型疫情,截至今年6/14,累計2,117例確定病例與7例死亡(多為免疫低下者)。疫情已擴及全國60%的行政區(69/115),主要影響15-49 歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(超過7.9萬人施打),惟面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流與醫療量能挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。
jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 31 May this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 185,882 confirmed cases, including 509 deaths. In May this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.3%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (649), China (89), France (63), Australia (50) and Germany (45), and 63.9% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with April this year, case numbers rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions and declined in other regions. Norway reported its first clade Ib case, and Poland's earlier clade I case has been identified as a clade Ib sub-lineage. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (4 May–14 June), 10 countries reported 790 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.45%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar, Kenya, Guinea, South Sudan, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outside Africa, Spain and Thailand continued to report clade Ib community transmission. Madagascar has faced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 14 June this year, 2,117 confirmed cases and 7 deaths (mostly among immunocompromised people) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 60% of the country's administrative areas (69 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15 to 49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has been rolled out (more than 79,000 people vaccinated), the outbreak remains uncontrolled because of challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics and health system capacity.

TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

x0YgmFJ-i4jFZr08fKzFjw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續攀升,截至5/26累計報告1,011例病例,其中105例確診、233例死亡,致死率(CFR)達23%。加拿大於5/26宣布禁止DRC與烏干達之公民入境,禁令為期90天;泰國5/26宣布自DRC與烏干達入境之旅客須進行21天入境檢疫;印度於各大機場啟動篩檢與監測措施,5/26報告1例自烏干達境外移入之疑病例,於5/27檢驗呈陰性,已排除風險。
x0YgmFJ-i4jFZr08fKzFjw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to grow: as of 26 May, 1,011 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 105 confirmed cases and 233 deaths, with a CFR of 23%. On 26 May, Canada announced a 90-day entry ban on citizens of the DRC and Uganda. On the same day, Thailand announced that travellers entering from the DRC and Uganda must undergo 21 days of entry quarantine. India has launched screening and surveillance measures at major airports; on 26 May it reported one suspected case imported from Uganda, which tested negative on 27 May, so the risk was ruled out.

cbDom3FBxnFTdur8ETRmxA.zh: 泰國於今年迄 4 月 20 日期間,全國累計報告 672 例,目前無死亡病例。疫情集中於東部(春武里府、羅勇府、尖竹汶府)及曼谷,病患以青壯年族群為主。當局正進行流行病學調查、加強水質監測及衛生系統品質,並呼籲民眾落實飲食安全與手部衛生。
cbDom3FBxnFTdur8ETRmxA.en: From the start of this year through 20 April, Thailand reported 672 cases cumulatively nationwide, with no deaths so far. Cases are concentrated in the eastern provinces (Chon Buri, Rayong and Chanthaburi) and Bangkok, mainly among working-age adults. Authorities are conducting epidemiological investigations, strengthening water quality monitoring and improving health system quality, and urge people to practise food safety and hand hygiene.

aUW_bjR3NvH1CmMp7J8YYw.zh: 泰國今年截至 4/16 累計報告 732 例病例,多分布於東北部地區,其中 23 例死亡,高風險族群包括 50 歲以上者、農民及具慢性病個案,往年疫情多發生於雨季(5-10 月),惟今年 1-4 月疫情異常增加。該國過去 1 年約報告 2,000 病例,惟推估實際數應為 7,000 例病例,其中2,800 例死亡,另研究顯示該病在該國動物族群中廣泛存在。
aUW_bjR3NvH1CmMp7J8YYw.en: Thailand has reported 732 cases cumulatively this year as of 16 April, mainly in the northeast, with 23 deaths. High-risk groups include people over 50, farmers and people with chronic illness. In past years, outbreaks mostly occurred in the rainy season (May–October), but this year cases rose abnormally between January and April. The country reported about 2,000 cases in the past year, but the estimated actual figure is 7,000 cases, of which 2,800 died. Studies show the disease is widespread in the country's animal population.

6EOF_Poxxi-BpZLZSIKAsA.zh: 泰國今年第 6-14 週每週皆報告逾 40 例病例,疫情為去年同期 2 倍,病患多分布於曼谷、春武里、羅勇和尖竹汶府等東部省份,病毒透過未煮熟食物、不安全的飲用水/冰塊傳播,當局警告可能於夏季爆發疫情,呼籲民眾應注意飲食/水衛生。
6EOF_Poxxi-BpZLZSIKAsA.en: In Thailand, more than 40 cases were reported each week from week 6 to week 14 of this year, double the level of the same period last year. Cases are mainly distributed in Bangkok and eastern provinces such as Chon Buri, Rayong and Chanthaburi. The virus spreads through undercooked food and unsafe drinking water or ice. Authorities warn that an outbreak may occur in summer and urge people to observe food and water hygiene.

qcbXlbtZARABsnnqH7c4Zw.zh: 泰國今年截至3/9累計報告逾13萬例病例,其中15,041例住院,8例死亡,發生率以北部帕堯/南邦/彭世洛/清邁府及東部烏汶府為高,年齡層發生率則以5-9歲為多,其次為0-4歲,死亡病患多為60歲以上長者,尤以具慢性病史或未接種過疫苗者為主。當局表示近1週病例數下降且低於去(2025)年同期,惟仍高於過去5年平均,流感於社區持續傳播,呼籲民眾落實個人衛生,該國去年累計報告逾110萬例病例,預期今年病例數將高於去年。
qcbXlbtZARABsnnqH7c4Zw.en: Thailand reported more than 130,000 cases cumulatively this year through 9 March, of which 15,041 were hospitalized and 8 died. Incidence is highest in the northern provinces of Phayao, Nan, Phitsanulok and Chiang Mai, and in the eastern province of Ubon Ratchathani. By age, incidence is highest among those aged 5–9 years, followed by those aged 0–4 years. Deaths were mainly among people over 60, especially those with chronic conditions or who had not been vaccinated. Authorities say case numbers fell over the past week and are lower than the same period last year, but remain higher than the five-year average. Influenza continues to spread in the community, and the public is urged to maintain personal hygiene. The country reported more than 1.1 million cases last year, and case numbers this year are expected to exceed last year's.

uVIcXuU9xL_VQBMyGPVgYQ.zh: 泰國今年截至2/10共計28府區報告49例確定病例,其中3例死亡,以男性及60歲以上年齡層為多,分布以東北部呵叻府為高,其次為北部帕府、東部春武里府,主要風險因素包括食用未煮熟之豬肉或豬血,及未穿戴防護裝備(靴子和手套)進行生豬屠宰作業。當局已發布指南,提醒民眾避免食用生或未煮熟之豬肉,並購買經認證來源之豬肉,另倘接觸豬隻應穿戴相關防護設備。
uVIcXuU9xL_VQBMyGPVgYQ.en: Thailand has reported 49 confirmed cases this year as of 10 February, across 28 provinces and districts, including 3 deaths. Cases are mainly among men and people aged over 60. Incidence is highest in Nakhon Ratchasima Province in the northeast, followed by Phrae Province in the north and Chon Buri Province in the east. Main risk factors include eating undercooked or raw pork or pig blood, and slaughtering pigs without protective equipment such as boots and gloves. Authorities have issued guidance reminding people to avoid eating raw or undercooked pork, to buy pork from certified sources, and to wear protective equipment when handling pigs.

mcbtGMcUZqptbmofphXtoQ.zh: 泰國呵叻府於2/21報告1例死亡病例,病患曾於2個月前經犬隻抓傷,且未接種疫苗。經調查該犬隻行為異常,且於該事件後不久死亡,當局已啟動疫情監測及調查作業。另提醒民眾,倘被犬貓抓/咬傷,應立即清洗傷口並儘速接種疫苗。
mcbtGMcUZqptbmofphXtoQ.en: In Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand, one death was reported on 21 February. The patient had been scratched by a dog two months earlier and had not been vaccinated. Investigation found the dog had shown abnormal behaviour and died shortly after the incident, and authorities have launched surveillance and investigation. Residents are also reminded that if bitten or scratched by a dog or cat, they should immediately wash the wound and get vaccinated as soon as possible.

aRgsqDfyqOG1VdVgZxG1mw.zh: 中國安徽省2/3報告3例住院病例,病患為同一家人,經接觸家中飼養3隻異常死亡的鸚鵡後發病,病患現已痊癒。 泰國於2/3報告該國首例病例,個案具慢性病史且於2025年年底通報,其於家中通風不良處飼養鳥類,清理鳥籠時未佩戴口罩、手套等防護裝備,病患經治療後已痊癒。
aRgsqDfyqOG1VdVgZxG1mw.en: In Anhui Province, China, three hospitalized cases were reported on 3 February. The patients were members of the same family and fell ill after contact with three parrots kept at home that had died unusually. The patients have now recovered. Thailand reported its first case on 3 February. The patient had a chronic disease history and had been notified at the end of 2025. The patient kept birds in a poorly ventilated area of the home and did not wear protective equipment such as masks and gloves when cleaning bird cages. The patient has recovered after treatment.

Hui_LEpiXrbx6tBZ8oOK8g.zh: 泰國今年截至1/21累計報告9例確定病例,自2022年截至1/25累計報告1,032例確定病例,以30-39歲男性族群為多,當局表示目前僅發現零星病例,未爆發大規模疫情,將持續進行監測、篩檢及高風險族群衛教宣導等工作。另建議民眾倘有發燒、皮疹或膿皰等症狀,且具相關風險因子,應立即就醫,並避免與他人密切接觸。泰國疾管局1/30
Hui_LEpiXrbx6tBZ8oOK8g.en: Thailand reported 9 confirmed cases this year as of 21 January, and 1,032 confirmed cases cumulatively since 2022 as of 25 January, mainly among men aged 30–39. Authorities say only sporadic cases have been found so far and no large-scale outbreak has occurred; surveillance, screening and health education for high-risk groups will continue. The public is advised that anyone with fever, rash or pustules and relevant risk factors should seek medical care immediately and avoid close contact with others. Source: Thailand Department of Disease Control, 30 January.

5QZf0mjYYBhOWpRl9MbNtA.zh: 泰國自2022年通報首例以來,迄今累計報告近1,000例病例,97%病患為男性,多數有非固定的性伴侶,病例主要分佈於曼谷、春武里、清邁及普吉島等觀光客多的地區,當局已針對高風險性行為者施打逾2,000劑疫苗。 馬達加斯加自2025年發現疫情以來,截至今年1/16累計通報290例疑病例,其中78例已確診(含8例兒童),迄無死亡病例,疫情主要集中在西北部博埃區,病毒型別為Ib型。當局與國際機構已加強監測與治療等防治措施,並計劃推行M痘疫苗接種措施。
5QZf0mjYYBhOWpRl9MbNtA.en: Thailand has reported nearly 1,000 cumulative cases since its first case in 2022. 97% of patients are male, most with non-fixed sexual partners, and cases are concentrated in tourist areas including Bangkok, Chon Buri, Chiang Mai and Phuket. Authorities have administered more than 2,000 vaccine doses to people engaging in high-risk sexual behaviour. Madagascar has reported 290 suspected cases cumulatively since an outbreak was detected in 2025, as of 16 January this year, of which 78 have been confirmed (including 8 children). No deaths have been reported. The outbreak is mainly concentrated in the Boeny region in the northwest, and the virus type is clade Ib. Authorities and international organisations have strengthened surveillance and treatment, and plan to roll out mpox vaccination.

ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.zh: 全球疫情更新,2025年截至12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,WHO表示季節期間多個區域爆發廣泛疫情,包括先前傳播率較低或無傳播之地區,評估全球傳播風險為中。各區署疫情如下:  美洲區病例為多,該區共16國累計報告291,451例病例(110,039例確診)及141例死亡,以巴西報告243,915例病例及116例死亡為多;  東南亞區累計報告115,985例病例(7,097例確診),主要分布於印度及泰國,其中印度截至8/31累計報告108,379例疑病例及4,995例確診病例; 歐洲區累計56,986例確診病例及43例死亡,其中法國及義大利報告本土病例,另法屬留旺島累計54,555例確診病例及43例死亡,法屬馬約特島累計報告1,259例本土病例; 西太平洋區共11國/地區累計34,035例確診病例及2例死亡,其中中國累計29,497例本土確診病例,主要分布於該國廣東省25,826例; 非洲區累計報告2,211例病例(111例確診),以模里西斯共和國報告1,583例病例為多,葛摩、肯亞、塞內加爾亦報告病例; 東地中海區累計報告1,596例病例(67例確診),其中巴基斯坦及索馬利亞報告病例。
ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The European Region reported 56,986 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively. France and Italy reported local cases. Separately, French Réunion reported 54,555 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, and French Mayotte reported 1,259 local cases cumulatively. The Western Pacific Region reported 34,035 confirmed cases and 2 deaths cumulatively across 11 countries and areas; China reported 29,497 local confirmed cases, mainly 25,826 in Guangdong province. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported 1,596 cases cumulatively (67 confirmed), with Pakistan and Somalia reporting cases.

6LF4K4nG7wRKreqEpbBxMA.zh: 中國第49-50週(12/1-14)累計報告5萬6,554例病例,其中重症20 例、無死亡病例,病例數較前2週下降43%,惟仍較去年同期高134%;越南胡志明市疫情略降,第49週新增1,484例病例,較前1週減少17%;韓國疫情上下波動,第49週就診陽性率增為5.9‰,高於近3年同期;泰國疫情下降,第50週累計報告848例,低於去年同期。
6LF4K4nG7wRKreqEpbBxMA.en: China reported 56,554 cases in weeks 49–50 (1–14 December), including 20 severe cases and no deaths. Case numbers fell 43% compared with the previous two weeks but remain 134% higher than the same period last year. In Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, the outbreak eased slightly, with 1,484 new cases in week 49, a 17% decrease from the previous week. In South Korea, the situation fluctuated; the outpatient visit positivity rate rose to 5.9 per 1,000 in week 49, higher than the same period over the past three years. In Thailand, the situation declined, with 848 cases reported cumulatively in week 50, lower than the same period last year.

4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.zh: WHO於12/10報告今(2025)年截至11/30,全球季節性流感自10月起活動度上升,目前全球流行以 A(H3N2) 為主,另自8月起,多國之K分支檢出率上升,北半球部分國家的流感季較往年提早,南半球部分國家的流感季節較往年延長。西太平洋區自10 月起活動度增加,日本及韓國提早進入流感季,紐西蘭及斐濟活動度處高峰或上升, GISAID資料顯示截至11/21,西太平洋區之病毒序列有89%為K分支;東南亞地區自6月上升,8月達高峰後趨緩,惟部分國家活動度仍偏高,另GISAID資料顯示泊爾、印度、泰國已檢出K分支;北美洲地區活動度上升,美國及加拿大K分支檢出率增加;歐洲地區部份國家第45-46 週陽性率超過10%,流感季較往年提前約4週開始,其中西歐較早上升,65 歲以上住院比例增加;WHO 評估全球流感活動度上升仍在預期範圍,流感病毒與其他呼吸道病毒共同流行,可能對醫療系統造成壓力,多國已檢出A(H3N2) K分支,目前證據未顯示K分支有致疾病嚴重度提升之情形,疫苗仍預期能降低重症風險。
4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.en: WHO reported on 10 December that, as of 30 November this year, global seasonal influenza activity has risen since October, with A(H3N2) currently predominant worldwide. Since August, detection of subclade K has increased in several countries. Some northern hemisphere countries' flu seasons began earlier than usual, and some southern hemisphere countries' seasons were longer than usual. In the Western Pacific Region, activity has increased since October, with Japan and South Korea entering the flu season early; New Zealand and Fiji are at or rising towards peak activity. GISAID data show that as of 21 November, 89% of virus sequences in the Western Pacific Region belonged to subclade K. In Southeast Asia, activity rose from June, peaked in August and then eased, although activity remains high in some countries; GISAID data show subclade K has been detected in Nepal, India and Thailand. In North America, activity has risen, with increased subclade K detection in the United States and Canada. In some European countries, test positivity exceeded 10% in weeks 45–46; the flu season began about four weeks earlier than usual, with Western Europe rising first, and hospitalisation among people aged 65 and over has increased. WHO assesses that the rise in global influenza activity is within the expected range. Influenza viruses are circulating alongside other respiratory viruses, which may put pressure on health systems. Several countries have detected A(H3N2) subclade K. Current evidence does not show that subclade K causes more severe disease, and vaccines are still expected to reduce the risk of severe illness.

Sl8VkzOfz7xQObuGJc98Lw.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,第48週(11/24-30)新增1,484例病例,較前4週平均增加0.9%,今年迄今累計達34,127例,該病每年流行高峰期為9-12月;中國疫情自高點下降,11月報告26萬9,337例病例,其中1例死亡,雖較10月疫情(37萬例)略降,惟仍為去年同期4.5倍;韓國疫情下降,第48週就診陽性率5.2‰,仍高於近3年同期;泰國疫情下降,第49週累計報告820例,低於去年同期。
Sl8VkzOfz7xQObuGJc98Lw.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, continues to rise: 1,484 new cases were reported in week 48 (24–30 November), an increase of 0.9% over the average of the previous four weeks. Cumulatively this year, 34,127 cases have been reported. The disease's annual peak season is September to December. China's situation has declined from its peak: 269,337 cases were reported in November, including 1 death. Although this is slightly lower than October (about 370,000 cases), it is 4.5 times the same period last year. South Korea's situation has declined; the outpatient visit positivity rate in week 48 was 5.2 per 1,000, still higher than the same period over the past three years. Thailand's situation has declined; 820 cases were reported cumulatively in week 49, lower than the same period last year.

ClamUptlJjU_dzM3Luh6vQ.zh: 韓國疫情上升,第47週(11/16-22)就診陽性率5.9‰,為近3年同期最高;泰國疫情下降,第48週(11/23-29)累計報告1,179例,低於去年同期;日本疫情處低點,第47週(11/17-23)定醫平均報告數0.12,已連續10週下降,且低於近3年同期。
ClamUptlJjU_dzM3Luh6vQ.en: South Korea: Outbreak rising. The test-positivity rate among clinic visits in week 47 (16–22 November) was 5.9‰, the highest for the same period in the past three years. Thailand: Outbreak declining. A cumulative 1,179 cases were reported in week 48 (23–29 November), lower than the same period last year. Japan: Outbreak at a low point. The average number of reports per sentinel medical facility in week 47 (17–23 November) was 0.12; this has declined for 10 consecutive weeks and is below the same period of the past three years.

dOPtKAavUjOeq-N-Tqvgsg.zh: 泰國疫情上升,第47週(11/16-22)累計報告1,466例,高於去年同期;日本疫情處低點,第46週定醫平均報告數0.13,已連續9週下降,且低於近3年同期;辛巴威首都哈拉雷(Harare)於11/20報告575例病例,5歲以下病患占9成,疫情集中於高人口密度地區,並擴散至鄰近區域。
dOPtKAavUjOeq-N-Tqvgsg.en: Thailand: Outbreak rising. In week 47 (16–22 November), a cumulative 1,466 cases were reported, higher than the same period last year. Japan: Outbreak at a low point. In week 46, the average number of reports per sentinel medical facility was 0.13; this has declined for nine consecutive weeks and is below the same period of the past three years. Zimbabwe: On 20 November, the capital Harare reported 575 cases, 90% of whom are under 5 years old. The outbreak is concentrated in areas of high population density and has spread to neighboring areas.

eJ0-p25kVJpj7IAlNlQrCg.zh: 亞洲多國疫情持續,  日本東京都第46週(11/10-16)定點門診平均病例數為44.75人,共計有1,696所學校/機構採取停課等措施,為去年同期14倍,當局表示國際流行之「H3」型K次演化群已於日本檢出,自今年9月迄今,H3檢體之K次演化群檢出率為92.3%(12/13); 韓國第43-46週病例數呈指數型上升,住院人數顯著上升,病患主要為學齡兒童及青少年,本季高峰期較去年提早2個月,以H3N2為主要流行株,另已檢出變異株,惟當局確認現有疫苗仍對該病毒株有效; 香港今年流感季累計報告21例兒童重症病例,其中2例死亡,第47週單週報告3例兒童重症病例,當局表示本流感季兒童感染嚴重個案較多,6個月至2歲以下兒童疫苗覆蓋率僅近16%,呼籲家長儘速安排兒童疫苗接種作業; 泰國今年截至11/8累計報告逾94萬例病例,其中100例死亡,病患主要為14歲以下年齡層,當局建議高風險族群應每年接種疫苗。
eJ0-p25kVJpj7IAlNlQrCg.en: Outbreaks continue in several Asian countries. Tokyo Metropolitan Government: In week 46 (10–16 November), the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 44.75, and a total of 1,696 schools and facilities took measures such as class suspensions, 14 times the same period last year. Authorities said the internationally circulating H3 subclade K has been detected in Japan; since September this year, the detection rate of H3 subclade K among specimens has been 92.3% (12/13). South Korea: Cases rose exponentially in weeks 43–46, with hospitalizations rising significantly, mainly among school-age children and adolescents. The peak this season came two months earlier than last year, with H3N2 as the predominant strain. Variant strains have also been detected, but authorities have confirmed that existing vaccines remain effective against this strain. Hong Kong: A cumulative 21 severe pediatric cases have been reported this flu season, including 2 deaths; 3 severe pediatric cases were reported in week 47 alone. Authorities said severe infections in children have been more frequent this season, and vaccine coverage among children aged 6 months to under 2 years is only about 16%; parents are urged to arrange vaccination promptly. Thailand: A cumulative total of more than 940,000 cases and 100 deaths had been reported as of 8 November this year. Most patients are under 14 years old, and authorities recommend annual vaccination for high-risk groups.

8IcjfBILNqsTlU2m9ynBoQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第43週(10/20-26)全球陽性率9.04%,其中,非洲及東地中海區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第44週(10/27-11/2)定醫平均報告數2.28,與前1週相當,病患地理分布以東京都、愛知縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第43週陽性率9.23%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 泰國疫情處低點,第45週(11/2-8)新增572例病例,病患年齡以30-39歲為大宗,病患地理分布以曼谷為多。 歐洲疫情呈下降趨勢,第44週陽性率7.9%,較9月中旬陽性率高峰(23.3%)已明顯下降,以變異株XFG占比最高(81%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,其中,惟西太平洋及東地中海區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
8IcjfBILNqsTlU2m9ynBoQ.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 43 of 2025 (20–26 October) was 9.04%, with positivity increasing in the Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regional offices. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 44 (27 October–2 November), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 2.28, similar to the previous week; cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Aichi prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 43 was 9.23%, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Thailand: The outbreak is at a low point. In week 45 (2–8 November), 572 new cases were reported; most patients are aged 30–39, and cases are concentrated in Bangkok. Europe: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 44 was 7.9%, markedly lower than the mid-September peak of 23.3%; the variant XFG has the highest share (81%). Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been declining, but it is rising in the Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regional offices. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

sm6D6nUjZRi4Rl1MNVt1Gw.en: Japan: In week 40 (29 September–5 October), the average number of influenza cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 1.56, rising for four consecutive weeks. Japan declared the start of its flu season on 3 October. Okinawa Prefecture had the highest figure, at 12.18, and 36 prefectures saw an increase from the previous week. Experts say this year's outbreak began somewhat earlier than in past years, but current weather is not as cold and dry as in winter, so a large-scale outbreak is unlikely at this stage; developments should nevertheless be monitored and protective measures taken. Thailand: An outbreak has occurred. So far this year, more than 700,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 65 died. Most cases are older adults and children, with the largest number among children aged 5–9, and most deaths are among people over 60. Because the rainy season has ended and the weather is turning cooler, the risk of respiratory infection has increased, and authorities urge people to get vaccinated and avoid crowded places. Authorities say cluster incidents rose in all states, with the most in Selangor (43), followed by Kuala Lumpur/Putrajaya (15). CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Because of holiday population movement, weather and other factors, transmission risk continues to increase. The area has launched a Level III public health emergency response and is fully carrying out prevention and control work. Globally, the outbreak continues: as of 30 September this year, 40 countries had reported 445,271 cases and 155 deaths cumulatively. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. In Europe, France and Italy reported locally acquired cases. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. Senegal reported its first case in August this year; as of 23 September, a cumulative 4 cases had been reported. The first case was an imported clade Ib case. Authorities have identified 40 contacts. Ireland reported three confirmed clade Ib cases and one suspected case on 18 September. The first confirmed case was epidemiologically linked to a suspected case with travel history to the Middle East; the other two confirmed cases were close contacts of the first, one of whom was a child. All patients have recovered. Authorities assess the country's risk as still low and urge travellers abroad to take necessary public health measures. The first case had travel history to China, and authorities have conducted an investigation and identified contacts. Authorities have investigated and followed up contacts, and have helped administer post-exposure vaccines. Assessment and recommendations: On 5 September, WHO, following the fifth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee, recommended ending the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). At a press conference, WHO said case and death numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Sierra Leone and Uganda continue to decline, risk factors for transmission and severity are increasingly understood, and affected countries have established sustained response capacity, so the event no longer constitutes a PHEIC. WHO cautioned that ending the PHEIC does not mean the threat has disappeared, and Africa CDC continues to treat the event as an emergency health event in Africa. WHO assesses the global public health risk as moderate. Because different genotypes continue to circulate, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, funding is lacking, and community engagement requires more resources, WHO has extended its long-term recommendations to August 2026.

Authorities urge people with international travel history who develop symptoms to seek medical care promptly. From 2022 to 12 September this year, Japan has cumulatively reported 254 cases, including one death.

71fypyp3-k5X34HyvOXCVg.zh: 泰國公布曼谷及北欖府之11個區域被列為警戒區,曼古府巴域(Prawet)區於9/9報告出現動物感染疫情,當局警告該地區及週邊5公里半徑範圍內,共計11個地區之居民應嚴避免與該地區之流浪動物接觸,倘民眾被抓咬傷或觸摸疑狂犬病之動物,應用肥皂清洗傷口並立即就醫接種疫苗。如發現犬/貓/動物死亡或出現咬東西等疑症狀,應通報動物管理及收容相關單位。
71fypyp3-k5X34HyvOXCVg.en: Thailand has designated 11 areas in Bangkok and Nonthaburi Province as alert zones. Prawet District in Bangkok reported animal infections on 9 September. Authorities warn residents of the area and of the 11 districts within a 5-km radius to strictly avoid contact with stray animals in the area. If a person is bitten or scratched, or touches an animal suspected of having rabies, the wound should be washed with soap and the person should seek medical care immediately for vaccination. If a dog, cat or other animal is found dead, or shows suspicious symptoms such as biting objects, it should be reported to animal management and shelter units.

4LGpe57ioFURvAWgZz8w9w.zh: 泰國今年截至8/5累計約4.8萬例病例,為去年同期1.7倍,病患多小於5歲,主要分布於南部、曼谷及中部地區;當局評估此波疫情與季節性氣候之強降雨及高濕度有關,疫情可能持續。
4LGpe57ioFURvAWgZz8w9w.en: As of 5 August this year, Thailand had cumulatively reported approximately 48,000 cases, 1.7 times the same period last year. Most patients are under 5 years old, and cases are mainly distributed in the southern region, Bangkok and central areas. Authorities assess that this wave of the outbreak is related to seasonal heavy rainfall and high humidity, and the outbreak may continue.

vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.zh: 以色列今年4月截至8/10累計報告410例,當局評估該國感染人數介於950-1,700人間,並報告22例住院,其中包含2名嬰幼兒重症案例,該國已啟動疫苗接種活動。 蒙古今年截至8/7累計報告逾1.3萬例,其中10例死亡,病例多為未接種疫苗之兒童,該國於2015-16年期間爆發疫情,報告140例死亡,多數為嬰幼兒。 韓國今年截至8/9累計報告68例,其中49例境外移入及19例與境外移入病例相關病例,病例數為去年同期1.4倍,感染國家以越南42例為多,餘有南非/烏茲別克/泰國/義大利/蒙古,病例多為19歲以上成年人,過半數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不詳。 日本東京都病例數上升,今年截至8/7累計報告28例,超過去年全年病例數(10例),因連續假期將至,外出返鄉人潮增加,當局加強警戒。
vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.en: Israel: 410 cases have been reported since April this year, as of 10 August. Authorities estimate that the number of infected people in the country is between 950 and 1,700. A total of 22 cases were hospitalized, including two severe cases in infants and young children, and the country has launched a vaccination campaign. Mongolia: as of 7 August this year, more than 13,000 cases had been cumulatively reported, including 10 deaths; cases are mostly in unvaccinated children. Mongolia had an outbreak in 2015–16 that reported 140 deaths, most of them infants and young children. South Korea: as of 9 August this year, 68 cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 49 were imported and 19 were linked to imported cases; case numbers are 1.4 times those of the same period last year. Most infections were acquired in Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from South Africa, Uzbekistan, Thailand, Italy and Mongolia. Most cases are adults aged 19 and over, and more than half were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Tokyo Metropolis, Japan: case numbers are rising; as of 7 August this year, 28 cases had been cumulatively reported, exceeding last year's full-year total of 10 cases. With the holiday period approaching and more people travelling out and returning home, authorities have increased vigilance.

KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告逾360萬例病例及2,000例死亡,以美洲地區報告逾330萬例病例為多,其中病例主要分布於巴西;今年亞洲地區之印累計89,845例病例、馬來西亞35,348例、斯里蘭卡31,544例、越南28,787例、泰國24,372例及孟加拉20,218例;非洲地區累計10國報告9,266例病例及18例死亡。
KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.en: Globally, more than 3.6 million cases and 2,000 deaths have been cumulatively reported this year, with the Americas region accounting for more than 3.3 million cases, mainly in Brazil. In Asia this year, Indonesia has cumulatively reported 89,845 cases, Malaysia 35,348, Sri Lanka 31,544, Viet Nam 28,787, Thailand 24,372 and Bangladesh 20,218. In Africa, 10 countries have reported 9,266 cases and 18 deaths cumulatively.

bUCX9RjRekF0DzITYjCXaQ.zh: 亞洲國家第28-30週(7/6-26)疫情更新,日本疫情持平,定醫平均病例數0.59,低於近3年同期;新加坡疫情處低點,平均每日新增20例病例,與前兩週相同;泰國今年截至7月累計報告3.4萬例,死亡0例,最常見的病患年齡組依序為0-4歲、5-9歲、10-14歲。
bUCX9RjRekF0DzITYjCXaQ.en: Update for Asian countries for weeks 28–30 (6–26 July): Japan's outbreak is flat, with a sentinel average of 0.59, lower than the same period over the past three years. Singapore's outbreak is at a low level, with an average of 20 new cases per day, the same as in the previous two weeks. Thailand reported 34,000 cases cumulatively this year as of July, with no deaths; the most common age groups among patients are 0–4, 5–9 and 10–14 years, in that order.

KxUTIs1wBj0fEtA-J-vEaQ.zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,今年截至7/17累計報告3,037例病例,於7/13-31期間通報569例病例,當局表示該國連續數週暴風雨,導致病例增加,提醒民眾避免涉水,並於接觸後,清洗身體,倘出現相關症狀,應立即就醫,另警告民眾未經醫師處方,不得自行用藥或服用抗生素。 泰國今年截至7/17報告1,895例病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:1.32%),病例/死亡數均以年齡60歲以上族群為多,當局建議民眾避免涉水或至泥濘區域,或應穿戴靴子和手套等防護裝備,並於接觸後,清洗身體,另倘於涉水後1-2週出現相關症狀,應立即就醫並告知接觸史。
KxUTIs1wBj0fEtA-J-vEaQ.en: The outbreak in the Philippines is rising: as of 17 July this year, 3,037 cases had been cumulatively reported, and 569 cases were reported between 13 and 31 July. Authorities say several consecutive weeks of storms have increased cases. They remind the public to avoid wading through water, to wash the body after contact, and to seek medical care immediately if symptoms appear. They also warn people not to self-medicate or take antibiotics without a doctor's prescription. Thailand reported 1,895 cases as of 17 July this year, including 25 deaths (CFR: 1.32%). Both cases and deaths are mainly in people aged over 60. Authorities recommend avoiding wading or muddy areas, or wearing protective gear such as boots and gloves, and washing the body after contact. If symptoms appear within one to two weeks after wading, people should seek medical care immediately and report their exposure history.

8jcvYLRsPEsvZd9IfrIooQ.zh: 泰國今年截至7/29累計報告2,036例,其中92例死亡(CFR:4.52%),病患職業以農民為主,年齡以60歲以上族群為多,主要分布於該國東北部,當局提醒民眾食用熟食及避免涉水或至泥濘區域,或應穿戴靴子及手套等防護裝備,並於接觸後,清洗身體,另呼籲農民及糖尿病患者,應留意自身感染風險。
8jcvYLRsPEsvZd9IfrIooQ.en: Thailand has reported 2,036 cases this year as of 29 July, including 92 deaths (CFR: 4.52%). Patients are mainly farmers and most are aged over 60, with cases mainly in the north-east of the country. Authorities remind the public to eat cooked food, to avoid wading or muddy areas or wear protective gear such as boots and gloves, and to wash the body after contact. Farmers and people with diabetes are urged to be aware of their own risk of infection.

qN7MMmw-cTKCcomL1Vjt6w.zh: 澳大利亞昆士蘭州今年截至7/20累計報告233例,其中35例死亡,病例數為去(2024)年同期3倍以上,病例多集中於凱恩斯及湯斯維爾區,專家推測疫情與降雨量高於平均及高速公路工程之環境影響相關。 泰國今年截至7/9累計報告1,676例,其中72例死亡,病患主要分布於東北地區,年齡以60歲以上族群為多,當局提醒民眾食用熟食及避免涉水或至泥濘區域,或應穿戴靴子和手套等防護裝備,並於接觸後清洗身體,另呼籲農民及糖尿病患者,應留意自身感染風險。
qN7MMmw-cTKCcomL1Vjt6w.en: Queensland, Australia, has reported 233 cases so far this year as of 20 July, including 35 deaths. This is more than three times the number in the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in the Cairns and Townsville areas. Experts suspect the outbreak is linked to above-average rainfall and the environmental impact of highway construction. Thailand has reported 1,676 cases so far this year as of 9 July, including 72 deaths. Cases are mainly in the northeast, and most patients are aged over 60. Authorities advise people to eat well-cooked food, avoid wading or entering muddy areas, wear protective gear such as boots and gloves where appropriate, and wash the body after exposure. Farmers and people with diabetes are also urged to be aware of their risk of infection.

3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.zh: 加拿大今年截至7/5共10省報告3,822例,其中以安大略省及亞伯達省為多,亞伯達省病例數上升,截至7/14報告逾1,200例,當地疫情嚴峻,該省已針對南部及北部部分地區發布警報,由於夏季大型集會增加及學校即將開學,預期疫情風險將持續。 美國今年迄今共39州報告1,288例,已報告27起疫情,病例數已超過2019年全年病例數,為該國宣布消除麻疹以來最高紀錄,該國有近1/3病例為20歲以上成人,92%個案未接種疫苗或接種史不明,自德州於今年1月發生大規模疫情後,已有多個州爆發小規模疫情,同時有大量境外移入個案。 韓國今年截至7/5累計報告65例,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關個案,感染地以越南(42例)為多,餘有烏茲別克、義大利、泰國及蒙古等國,病患多為19歲以上成年人。 英國利物浦報告1例兒童死亡案例,為英蘭地區近5年來第2例死亡,前1例為2023年大曼徹斯特10歲女童,英蘭地區今年迄今報告529例,以倫敦都會區為多,該地區去年報告2,900餘例,為2012年以來新高。
3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.en: Canada has reported 3,822 cases in 10 provinces as of 5 July this year, mainly in Ontario and Alberta. Alberta's case count has risen, with more than 1,200 cases reported as of 14 July. The epidemic there is severe, and the province has issued alerts for parts of the south and north. Because of increased large summer gatherings and the imminent start of school, the risk is expected to continue. The United States has reported 1,288 cases in 39 states so far this year, with 27 outbreaks reported. The number of cases has already exceeded the total for all of 2019, the highest since the country declared measles eliminated. Nearly one third of cases are adults aged over 20, and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Since a large outbreak in Texas in January this year, several states have experienced small outbreaks, alongside many imported cases. South Korea reported 65 cases as of 5 July this year, all imported or linked to imported cases. Most were from Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from Uzbekistan, Italy, Thailand and Mongolia, and most patients were adults aged 19 and over. In Liverpool, United Kingdom, one child died; this is the second death in England in five years, the previous being a 10-year-old girl in Greater Manchester in 2023. England has reported 529 cases so far this year, mainly in Greater London. England reported more than 2,900 cases last year, the highest since 2012.

3UFuWvIchT5KtUQqvc_Xrw.zh: 泰國疫情更新,今年截至7/7累計7例死亡病例,為去年同期3倍,90%病患感染來源為犬隻,10%為貓隻,當局呼籲民眾倘被犬貓抓咬傷,應立即就診並接種狂犬病疫苗,另飼主應定期為犬貓完整接種疫苗。
3UFuWvIchT5KtUQqvc_Xrw.en: Thailand's epidemic update: as of 7 July this year, 7 rabies deaths have been reported cumulatively, three times the same period last year. 90% of patients were infected by dogs and 10% by cats. Authorities urge anyone bitten or scratched by a dog or cat to seek medical care immediately and receive rabies vaccination. Pet owners should ensure dogs and cats are fully vaccinated on a regular schedule.

kZ9x0qH7K1pDnLCcRQcMlQ.zh: 泰國清邁府報告1例,病患接受治療及檢驗中,該國今年累計報告40例,自2022年迄今累計900例,其中13例死亡,當局表示病患多為本土感染,僅5例為境外移入,主要年齡層介於20-39歲,傳染途徑皆為性接觸,當局建議易感族群應採取安全性行為,並針對自非洲和中東等高風險地區返國之旅客採取篩檢措施。
kZ9x0qH7K1pDnLCcRQcMlQ.en: Chiang Mai Province in Thailand has reported one case, who is being treated and tested. Thailand has reported 40 cases this year, and 900 cumulative cases since 2022, of which 13 were fatal. Authorities say most patients were infected locally, and only 5 were imported cases. The main age group is 20–39 years, and all transmission was through sexual contact. Authorities advise susceptible groups to practice safe sex, and screening is being carried out for travelers returning from high-risk areas such as Africa and the Middle East.

lEhiroOiiIpi17CrLjFvWw.zh: 亞洲國家第24-26週(6/8-28)疫情更新,中國疫情上升,新增約8.8萬例病例,今年迄今累計253,093例,117例重症,無死亡案例;疫情低於近2年同期;香港疫情上升,就診陽性率為0.7‰,為今年最高點;日本疫情上升,定醫平均病例數0.33,為今年最高,惟低於近3年同期;越南今年截至4月累計報告逾1.5萬例病例,其中,胡志明市病例數較去年同期增加49%;泰國今年截至6月累計報告約2.4萬例病例,迄無死亡個案,病患年齡以0-4歲(70%)及10-14歲為多(22%)。
lEhiroOiiIpi17CrLjFvWw.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 24–26 (8–28 June): China's epidemic is rising, with about 88,000 new cases in the period. Cumulatively this year, 253,093 cases and 117 severe cases have been reported, with no deaths. The epidemic is lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Hong Kong's epidemic is rising, with a clinic positivity rate of 0.7‰, the highest point this year. Japan's epidemic is rising, with an average of 0.33 cases per sentinel clinic, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. Viet Nam reported more than 15,000 cumulative cases as of April this year, and cases in Ho Chi Minh City were 49% higher than in the same period last year. Thailand reported about 24,000 cumulative cases as of June this year, with no deaths. Patients are mainly aged 0–4 (70%) and 10–14 (22%).

ksxYENZEGP8hrNfhhCaBgg.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第20週(5/12-18)全球陽性率3.19%,除美洲以外,各區域陽性率皆顯著增加。 中國5月累計新增約44萬例病例,其中606例重症、7例死亡,於5/26達高峰後,每日新增病例數開始下降;陽性率上升至第21週達今年新高(23.8%)後,呈下降趨勢,南方省份陽性率高於北方,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(92%)。 香港第22週(5/25-31)陽性率9.27%,低於前兩週,疫情仍處高點,惟已呈明顯下降趨勢,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(94%)。 泰國今年截至5/27累計報告約21萬例病例,其中51例死亡,4月潑水節後,疫情持續上升,並以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(65%)。 印度今年截至4/6累計報告近5,000例病例,病例分布以喀拉拉邦(Kerala)及德里為多,並以變異株JN.1占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,東地中海、西太平洋、歐洲及東南亞區皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株以LP.8.1占比最高,NB.1.8.1占比持續上升。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
ksxYENZEGP8hrNfhhCaBgg.en: Epidemic update: in week 20 of 2025 (12–18 May), the global positivity rate was 3.19%, with significant increases in all regions except the Americas. China added about 440,000 cases in May, including 606 severe cases and 7 deaths. After peaking on 26 May, daily new cases began to decline. The positivity rate rose to this year's high of 23.8% in week 21 and has since declined; positivity in southern provinces is higher than in northern provinces, and the variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share (92%). Hong Kong's positivity rate in week 22 (25–31 May) was 9.27%, lower than in the previous two weeks. The outbreak remains at a high level but shows a clear downward trend, and the sentinel clinic consultation rate has also declined. Wastewater surveillance data show the variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share (94%). Thailand reported about 210,000 cases cumulatively this year as of 27 May, including 51 deaths. After the Songkran festival in April, cases continued to rise, with the variant NB.1.8.1 accounting for the largest share (65%). India reported nearly 5,000 cases cumulatively this year as of 6 April, mainly in Kerala and Delhi, with the variant JN.1 accounting for the largest share. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, including in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific, European and South-East Asian regions. The variant LP.8.1 currently accounts for the largest share globally, while the share of NB.1.8.1 continues to rise. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

kB6fePhBddX1PJ3_OhL_Rw.zh: 泰國東部沙繳府(Sa Kaeo)報告1例病例,為52歲男性,因頭/頸/四肢出現潰瘍症狀住院,經檢驗確診。據調查,病患曾於發病前一週食用生牛肉,當局已啟動調查及監測措施,並呼籲民眾避免接觸及食用生病及死亡動物。該國今年累積報告5例,其中1例死亡,本案為該府首起疫情。
kB6fePhBddX1PJ3_OhL_Rw.en: Sa Kaeo Province in eastern Thailand reported one case, in a 52-year-old man who was hospitalized with ulcers on the head, neck and limbs and confirmed by testing. Investigation found that the patient had eaten raw beef in the week before onset. Authorities have launched investigation and surveillance measures and urge people to avoid contact with, and consumption of, sick or dead animals. The country has reported 5 cases this year, including 1 death; this is the province's first outbreak.

inTze3rH1JE3fnDi5o6r7g.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第18週(4/28-5/4)全球陽性率約3%,陽性率以東地中海區、及西太平洋區為高。 泰國第20週(5/12-18)累計新增5.1萬例,為上週1.5倍,病例多介於30-39歲,評估4月潑水節活動致疫情快速上升;香港第20週(5/11-17)陽性率持續上升,惟有跡象顯示上升趨勢開始趨緩,定醫就診率亦呈上升趨勢,污水監測數據顯示,變異株XDV占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,東地中海、西太平洋、歐洲、東南亞區皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株以LP.8.1占比最高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
inTze3rH1JE3fnDi5o6r7g.en: Epidemic update: in week 18 of 2025 (28 April–4 May), the global positivity rate was about 3%, highest in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions. Thailand added 51,000 cases in week 20 (12–18 May), 1.5 times the previous week, with most cases among people aged 30–39. The rapid rise is assessed to be due to activities during the Songkran festival in April. Hong Kong's positivity in week 20 (11–17 May) continued to rise, but signs suggest the upward trend is starting to slow; sentinel clinic consultation rates have also risen, and wastewater surveillance data show the XDV variant accounts for the largest share. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, including in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific, European and South-East Asian regions, and the LP.8.1 variant currently accounts for the largest share globally. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

mAMotVJwrxwOa_Mj7ctetQ.zh: 亞洲國家第18-19週(4/27-6/3)疫情,新加坡疫情嚴峻,平均單日新增61例病例,為2020年以來最高;香港就診陽性率為0.4‰,與前週持平;日本定醫平均病例數0.09,與前週(0.1)相當,仍處疫情低點;韓國處疫情低點,就診陽性率為0.9‰,較前週略升;泰國疫情下降,第15-16週(4/6-4/19)新增929例。
mAMotVJwrxwOa_Mj7ctetQ.en: Update on Asian countries for weeks 18–19 (27 April–3 June): Singapore's outbreak is severe, with an average of 61 new cases per day, the highest since 2020. Hong Kong's clinic-visit positivity rate was 0.4‰, unchanged from the previous week. Japan's average sentinel clinic case count was 0.09, similar to the previous week (0.1), and it remains at a low point. Korea is at a low point, with a clinic-visit positivity rate of 0.9‰, slightly up from the previous week. Thailand's outbreak is declining, with 929 new cases in weeks 15–16 (6–19 April).

t0VR-yHL2ye_WArW53x7RA.zh: 泰國東北部穆達漢府(Mukdahan)疫情更新,自5/1報告首例,截至5/11累計4例確診病例,其中1例死亡、1例已出院、2例刻正治療中,另636例接觸者已完成監測,並無新增病例。當局呼籲倘有異常死亡之動物,切勿任意觸碰並應通知相關單位。
t0VR-yHL2ye_WArW53x7RA.en: Mukdahan Province in northeastern Thailand: the first case was reported on 1 May, and as of 11 May, 4 cases had been confirmed cumulatively, including 1 death, 1 discharged and 2 still under treatment. Monitoring of 636 close contacts has been completed, with no new cases. Authorities urge people not to touch animals that have died unusually, and to notify the relevant authorities.

1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.zh: 韓國今年迄今累計52例,病例數為去年同期的1.3倍,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關病例,感染國家以越南33例為多,另有烏茲別克/泰國/義大利各1例,超過60%的病例未接種疫苗或接種狀況不明,當局表示因新冠疫情後國際交流頻繁,且全球疫情持續,尤其是東南亞地區,由於持續有前往流行地區之病例輸入並造成傳播,需對境外移入風險保持警戒。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/1報告12起疫情,累計30州935例,其中121例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,北達科他州近期報告自2011年來首例;加拿大今年截至4/19共7省1,177例,以安大略省(993)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/6累計報告287例,為該省1987年以來最高;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)病例數遽增,今年迄今報告786例,並報告1例成年男性死亡案例,該國去年同期僅報告7例。 法國今年截至4/13累計報告427例,接近去(2024)年全年病例數(483),其中,全國近60%的省份報告病例,以1-4歲兒童為多,另報告58例併發症,9例於ICU治療,並報告1例成年死亡病例。
1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.en: South Korea has reported 52 cases so far this year, 1.3 times the same period last year. All cases were imported or linked to imported cases; the countries of infection were mainly Viet Nam with 33 cases, plus 1 each in Uzbekistan, Thailand and Italy. More than 60% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Authorities said that international exchange has been frequent since the COVID-19 pandemic and the global outbreak continues, especially in Southeast Asia; because cases continue to be imported from areas with outbreaks and cause transmission, vigilance against the risk of imported cases must be maintained. North America update: as of 1 May this year, the United States has reported 12 outbreaks, with 935 cases cumulatively across 30 states, including 121 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. North Dakota recently reported its first case since 2011. As of 19 April, Canada had 1,177 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (993); case numbers in Alberta have risen rapidly, with 287 cases reported cumulatively as of 6 May, the highest for the province since 1987. In Chihuahua State in northern Mexico, case numbers have surged, with 786 cases reported this year so far, including 1 adult male death; the country reported only 7 cases in the same period last year. France reported 427 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, close to last year's full-year total of 483. Nearly 60% of the country's provinces have reported cases, mainly among children aged 1–4. A total of 58 complications were reported, 9 of which were treated in the ICU, and 1 adult death was reported.

NGKxz8oXyIbBqIMCkL9zwg.zh: 泰國東北部穆達漢府(Mukdahan)爆發疫情,截至5/2累計報告2例確診病例,其中1例死亡,另有3例疑病例。首例為53歲男性,於4/24右手紅腫結節,於27日出現傷口變黑、淋巴結腫大、頭暈及抽搐等症狀就醫後死亡,經檢驗確診。病患曾參加宗教活動並宰殺牛隻,且分送村民食用;第2例為死者友人,一同宰殺牛隻,後出現皮膚水泡潰傷症狀,目前已住院接受抗生素治療,狀況良好;當局已追蹤當日宰殺牛隻等接觸者共600餘人,並對高風險族群預防性用藥,進行區域疫情管控,並安排當地牛隻施打疫苗。泰國於2000年報告15例,無死亡病例,2017年與緬甸鄰近之達府報告2例,皆曾處理山羊;鄰近之寮國於去(2024)年報告129例及1例死亡;越南於2023年報告3起與食用牛肉相關之疫情,累計報告13例。
NGKxz8oXyIbBqIMCkL9zwg.en: An outbreak has occurred in Mukdahan Province in northeastern Thailand. As of 2 May, 2 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 1 died, with 3 further suspected cases. The first case was a 53-year-old man who developed a red, swollen nodule on his right hand on 24 April; on 27 April he developed a blackened wound, lymph node swelling, dizziness and convulsions, and died after seeking medical care. Laboratory testing confirmed the diagnosis. The patient had attended a religious activity and slaughtered cattle, and the meat was shared with villagers to eat. The second case was a friend of the deceased who slaughtered the cattle together with him and later developed skin blisters and ulcers; he is now hospitalized receiving antibiotic treatment and is in good condition. Authorities have traced more than 600 contacts, including others who slaughtered cattle that day, given preventive medication to high-risk groups, implemented regional outbreak control measures, and arranged vaccination of local cattle. Thailand reported 15 cases in 2000 with no deaths. In 2017, Tak Province, which borders Myanmar, reported 2 cases, both of whom had handled goats. Neighboring Laos reported 129 cases and 1 death last year (2024). Viet Nam reported 3 outbreaks linked to beef consumption in 2023, with 13 cases cumulatively.

6Th9-a28KL0M7U4vMEnlNg.zh: 泰國自今年以來已通報2例死亡案例,1例在宋卡,另1例在曼谷,當局已發布警報,提醒民眾採取預防措施,該疾病在該國屬罕見疾病,自1996年迄今記錄40多例病例。
6Th9-a28KL0M7U4vMEnlNg.en: Thailand has reported 2 deaths since the beginning of this year, one in Songkhla and one in Bangkok. Authorities have issued an alert reminding the public to take precautionary measures. The disease is rare in Thailand, with more than 40 cases recorded since 1996.

bjd7Ue6BgaDQlPXFrX7F_w.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年4/20累計132國/地區報告13萬8,085例確診病例,其中至少317例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第16週累計68國/地區報告1萬7,373例確診病例,其中非洲區1萬4,564例、美洲區1,500例、西太平洋區344例、歐洲區913例、東南亞區26例及東地中海區26例。  其他更新:   WHO公布3/28-4/20期間共4國(英國、法國、瑞士、泰國)新增4例Ib型病例,中國新增2例Ia型病例,多數具中非地區旅遊史。  評估與建議:  WHO於2025/2/25召開針對2024年M痘疫情的IHR緊急委員會第三次會議,表示目前疫情仍嚴峻,剛果民主共和國(DRC)等國疫情規模仍不明確,且國際間報告Ib分支感染國家數倍增,又因資金援助刪減,影響疫苗及診斷資源可近性,故宣布此波疫情持續構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」。 另針對各分支風險評估如下:  Ia分支:於DRC傳播風險為中; Ib分支:於DRC及鄰近區域傳播風險為高; II分支:於奈及利亞及中、西非區域傳播風險為中; IIb分支 : 國際傳播風險為中。
bjd7Ue6BgaDQlPXFrX7F_w.en: Monthly update: as of 20 April this year, 132 countries and regions have reported 138,085 confirmed mpox cases cumulatively since May 2022, including at least 317 deaths (CFR 0.2%). As of week 16 this year, 68 countries and regions have reported 17,373 confirmed cases cumulatively this year: 14,564 in the African Region, 1,500 in the Region of the Americas, 344 in the Western Pacific Region, 913 in the European Region, 26 in the South-East Asia Region and 26 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Other updates: WHO reported that between 28 March and 20 April, 4 countries (the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland and Thailand) reported 4 new clade Ib cases, and China reported 2 new clade Ia cases; most had travel history to Central Africa. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February 2025. It stated that the outbreak remains severe, the scale of the outbreak in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains unclear, the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied internationally, and reduced funding is affecting access to vaccine and diagnostic resources. It therefore declared that this wave of the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Risk assessment by clade: clade Ia, transmission risk in the DRC is moderate; clade Ib, transmission risk in the DRC and neighboring areas is high; clade II, transmission risk in Nigeria and across Central and West Africa is moderate; clade IIb, international transmission risk is moderate.

cGNF2RXTPMlUva8rZjjhJg.zh: 亞洲部分國家疫情上升,中國今年1、2月各報告約2,200例病例,為去年同期2倍;日本今年截至4/6累計報告41例病例,高於去年同期(26例);印度今年截至2/23累計報告10起群聚案件,高於去年同期(2起),病患多分布於南部喀拉拉邦(Kerala);韓國今年截至4/12累計報告360例病例,與去年同期(369例)相當;泰國今年截至3/22累計報告189例病例,第11-12週(3/9-3/22)疫情下降。
cGNF2RXTPMlUva8rZjjhJg.en: Outbreaks are rising in some Asian countries. China reported about 2,200 cases in each of January and February this year, double the same period last year. Japan reported 41 cases cumulatively this year as of 6 April, higher than the 26 in the same period last year. India reported 10 clusters cumulatively this year as of 23 February, higher than the 2 in the same period last year, with cases mainly in Kerala State in the south. South Korea reported 360 cases cumulatively this year as of 12 April, comparable to the 369 in the same period last year. Thailand reported 189 cases cumulatively this year as of 22 March, and the outbreak declined in weeks 11–12 (9–22 March).

maWq8YafMCSzfZ3z2_vmPw.zh: 瑞典2024年累計報告1,612例病例,為近14年來新高,病患年齡中位數為42歲,檢出型別多為腸道沙門氏菌及傷寒沙門氏菌;經調查生產自烏克蘭之雞蛋及義大利之苜蓿芽為造成當年大規模疫情的主因,各造成逾百人之感染,另境外輸入病例多來自泰國。
maWq8YafMCSzfZ3z2_vmPw.en: Sweden reported 1,612 cases cumulatively in 2024, the highest in nearly 14 years, with a median patient age of 42. The types detected were mainly Salmonella enterica and Salmonella Typhi. Investigation found that eggs produced in Ukraine and alfalfa sprouts from Italy were the main causes of large-scale outbreaks that year, each infecting more than 100 people. Imported cases mainly came from Thailand.

U4tJVL8I_t9M7wYVjMOTpQ.zh: 泰國3/25報告自今年截至3/23累計3地區3例死亡,3例均曾被狗咬傷,且未接種疫苗。截至今年3/10,當局經檢驗發現動物檢體陽性率為6.19% (58/937)。 印度德里新增1例死亡病例,病患為成年女性,因飲用牛乳數日後死亡,據調查相關牛隻曾被流浪犬咬傷。當局提醒,牛隻被感染動物咬傷後其牛乳即可能含有病毒,應煮沸消毒;若傷口或黏膜被感染動物舔舐亦可能感染,應立即接受治療。
U4tJVL8I_t9M7wYVjMOTpQ.en: Thailand reported on 25 March that from the start of this year to 23 March, 3 deaths had been recorded cumulatively in 3 areas. All 3 had been bitten by dogs and were unvaccinated. As of 10 March this year, laboratory testing of animal samples found a positivity rate of 6.19% (58/937). India reported one new death in Delhi: an adult woman who died several days after drinking cow's milk. Investigation found the cow had been bitten by a stray dog. Authorities warn that milk from cattle bitten by an infected animal may contain the virus and should be boiled; infection can also occur if a wound or mucous membrane is licked by an infected animal, and treatment should be sought immediately.

G0IFEXgZLAW6mqT05R2WnA.zh: 歐洲報告2023年的淋病與梅毒病例數皆呈上升趨勢。淋病累計28國報告近10萬例確診病例,比2022年增加31%;梅毒累計29國通報4萬1千餘例確診,比2022年增加13%,MSM族群佔通報數之72%;披衣菌感染症累計27國報告逾23萬例病例,仍為最常見的細菌性性病,其中女性20-24歲族群占比最高;抗藥性淋病的菌株亦增加,當局將積極監控抗藥性趨勢。 泰國報告2024年性病呈上升趨勢,淋病每十萬人口發生率99.9例,較2018年增加1.6倍;梅毒為105.2例,較2018年增加3.8倍;愛滋病新增約8,869例病例,46%為15-24歲族群。
G0IFEXgZLAW6mqT05R2WnA.en: Europe reported rising gonorrhoea and syphilis cases in 2023. For gonorrhoea, 28 countries reported nearly 100,000 confirmed cases, a 31% increase over 2022. For syphilis, 29 countries reported over 41,000 confirmed cases, a 13% increase over 2022; men who have sex with men (MSM) accounted for 72% of reports. Chlamydia infection was reported by 27 countries, with over 230,000 cases, and remains the most common bacterial sexually transmitted infection; women aged 20–24 had the highest share. Drug-resistant gonorrhoea strains have also increased, and authorities will actively monitor resistance trends. Thailand reported rising STIs in 2024. The gonorrhoea rate was 99.9 per 100,000 population, 1.6 times the 2018 rate; the syphilis rate was 105.2, 3.8 times the 2018 rate. About 8,869 new HIV cases were reported, 46% of them among people aged 15–24.

Xaz6UYKjN8EsdLeUM7gG8w.zh: 美國流感活動於第6週(2/2-2/8)接近本流感季高峰,住院及死亡數皆上升,為2017-18年流感季以來,CDC首次將所有年齡層皆提升為最嚴重程度,其中,以24歲(含)以下族群最為嚴重。近2週住院數達2010-11年流感季以來最高,近一週死亡人數中,因流感死亡占比為2.6%,高於新冠的1.5%;第6週新增11例兒童因流感死亡報告,本流感季迄今累計68例。類流感門診就診率已連續11週高於閾,該國共計46個州之流感活動度為高及非常高。 泰國衛生部報告今年迄今已累計報告超過9.9萬例,其中9例死亡,病例數高於過去5年中位數,其中以該國東北部地區疫情最為嚴峻,當局呼籲高風險民眾儘速接種疫苗。
Xaz6UYKjN8EsdLeUM7gG8w.en: US influenza activity approached this season's peak in week 6 (2–8 February), with both hospitalizations and deaths rising. For the first time since the 2017–18 season, the CDC has raised the severity level for all age groups, with those aged 24 and under most severely affected. Hospitalizations over the past two weeks reached their highest level since the 2010–11 season. Among deaths reported in the past week, the share attributed to influenza was 2.6%, higher than the 1.5% attributed to COVID-19. In week 6, 11 new paediatric influenza deaths were reported, bringing the season's total to 68. Influenza-like illness outpatient visit rates have been above the threshold for 11 consecutive weeks. Influenza activity is high or very high in 46 states. Thailand's Ministry of Public Health reported over 99,000 cases so far this year, including 9 deaths; case numbers are above the five-year median. The outbreak is most severe in the northeast, and authorities urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

vmeDj96YPOeSKZ0ZaJy1qA.zh: 泰國自2024/1/1迄今年1/5累計報告956例病例,59例死亡,病例多發生於東北部和北部地區,多數死者有食用生豬肉或接觸其內臟等危險因子,且多具有慢性疾病。
vmeDj96YPOeSKZ0ZaJy1qA.en: Thailand reported 956 cases and 59 deaths cumulatively from 1 January 2024 to 5 January 2025. Cases occurred mainly in the northeast and north. Most of the deceased had risk factors such as eating raw pork or handling pork offal, and most had chronic illnesses.

hS9fZcHflOh9C8eMm9VR6A.zh: 緬甸東南部克倫邦水溝谷地區爆發疫情,2024 年截至 12/30 累計報告逾 700 例急性腹瀉病例,其中 2例死亡;與該地區接壤之泰國達府地區累計報告 4 例,當局已關閉邊境通道並提供緬甸醫療物資,在世界衛生組織等介入協助下,病例數已大幅減少。
hS9fZcHflOh9C8eMm9VR6A.en: An outbreak has occurred in the Shwe Kokko area of Kayin State in southeastern Myanmar. As of 30 December 2024, over 700 cases of acute diarrhoea had been reported cumulatively, including 2 deaths. Tak Province in neighbouring Thailand reported 4 cases cumulatively. Authorities have closed border crossings and provided medical supplies to Myanmar. With the assistance of WHO and other partners, case numbers have fallen substantially.

G1sgfVTzvfOWWQhMzwF1vA.zh: 香港12/13新增報告1例病例,為63歲具慢性病史男性,居住於深水埗,11/30發病,12/4死亡,感染源仍在調查中;當地今年累計報告23例病例,較去年17例為高。 美國波多黎各今年7至11月間新增報告6例病例,其中4例死亡,死者均為60歲以上老年族群,當局表示近幾月持續發生大雨及淹水,可能為疫情上升主因。 泰國今年截至12月中旬累計75省報告3,935例病例,其中127例死亡,病患多為男性,年齡層以65歲以上族群最多。
G1sgfVTzvfOWWQhMzwF1vA.en: Hong Kong reported one new case on 13 December: a 63-year-old man with a chronic illness, living in Sham Shui Po, who developed symptoms on 30 November and died on 4 December. The source of infection is still under investigation. Hong Kong has reported 23 cases cumulatively in 2024, higher than the 17 cases in 2023. In the United States, Puerto Rico reported six new cases between July and November 2024, four of which were fatal, all in people over 60; authorities say that heavy rain and flooding over recent months are the main reason for the rise. Thailand reported 3,935 cases cumulatively in 2024 up to mid-December across 75 provinces, with 127 deaths; patients are mostly male, and the largest age group is those aged 65 and over.

U2tpXFAnA9O6CCgUNObfzg.zh: 中國四川省11月報告2.6萬例病例,為10月份之3.4倍,整體而言南方流感活動度持平,北方10月起已逐漸上升;泰國整體流感疫情上升,高於去年同期,其中又以北部及東北地區升幅較明顯,當局呼籲民眾注意衛生並接種疫苗。
U2tpXFAnA9O6CCgUNObfzg.en: China: In November, Sichuan Province reported 26,000 cases, 3.4 times the number in October. Overall, influenza activity in southern China has been flat, while in northern China it has been rising since October. Thailand: Influenza activity has risen overall and is higher than the same period last year, with particularly marked increases in the northern and northeastern regions. Authorities urge the public to pay attention to hygiene and get vaccinated.

6-7cmsiMIu8R_15W1rZp6g.zh: 依WHO監測數據,泰國疫情於7月起驟升,達每月千餘例之規模,明顯高於往年;越南胡志明市9月起疫情爆發,疫情仍在上升,目前達每週300餘例之規模,並有擴散至鄰近同奈及平陽省之趨勢;馬來西亞今年疫情較往年嚴峻,惟下半年已趨緩;菲律賓、印疫情則持續流行,今年處於相對嚴峻之水平。
6-7cmsiMIu8R_15W1rZp6g.en: According to WHO surveillance data, Thailand's outbreak surged from July, reaching more than 1,000 cases a month, clearly higher than in previous years. In Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, an outbreak began in September and is still rising, currently at over 300 cases a week, and is spreading to neighbouring Đồng Nai and Bình Dương provinces. Malaysia's situation this year has been more severe than in previous years, but has eased in the second half of the year. The Philippines and Indonesia continue to have ongoing epidemics, which are at a relatively severe level this year.

N8qZIkaKCrRQLuXdYTuw7w.zh: 泰國東北部加拉信府疫情上升,今年截至12月初累計報告120例病例,其中3例死亡,當局表示東北地區發生率最高,且以務農工作者居多,呼籲民眾採取防護措施。 印度西北部拉賈斯坦邦12月初新增報告5例病例,為當地首起疫情,其中1例死亡;當局表示,因病原菌較適應潮濕環境,往年疫情多集中於中南部邦別,現在發生於乾旱地區,顯示菌株可能出現變化。
N8qZIkaKCrRQLuXdYTuw7w.en:
Cases are rising in Kalasin Province in northeastern Thailand. As of early December this year, 120 cases have been reported, including 3 deaths. Authorities say the Northeast has the highest incidence and that farmers make up most of those affected, and they urge people to take protective measures.

In Rajasthan State in northwestern India, 5 new cases were reported in early December, the first local outbreak in the area, including 1 death. Authorities say the pathogen is better adapted to humid environments, and past outbreaks were concentrated in central and southern states, whereas this outbreak is occurring in an arid region, suggesting the strain may be changing.

wMF8jOZZ0XTcjmWms4DNxw.zh: 泰國今年截至11/13累計報告1,290例病例,其中2例死亡(CFR:0.16%),分布以耶拉府575例最多,年齡層則以0至4歲佔6成為多,當局呼籲民眾按時接種疫苗。
wMF8jOZZ0XTcjmWms4DNxw.en: Thailand has reported 1,290 cases so far this year as of 13 November, including 2 deaths (CFR: 0.16%). Yala Province has the most cases, with 575. Children aged 0 to 4 years account for about 60% of cases. Authorities urge people to get vaccinated on schedule.

s1iXue-tu7tVHxv5_wIaxA.zh: 泰國疫情持續,今年截至9月累計報告2,881例病例,其中90例死亡(CFR:3%),多數病例為執行農/園藝工作,而有土壤及涉水等接觸史。
s1iXue-tu7tVHxv5_wIaxA.en: Melioidosis continues in Thailand. As of September this year, 2,881 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 90 deaths (CFR: 3%). Most patients were agricultural or gardening workers and had a history of contact with soil and water.

VRDw7yoWnJO_6GWT8nG7vA.zh: 泰國公布因食用未煮熟豬肉引起的相關疫情,1/7-9/3期間報告149例病例有聽力障礙症狀,迄今已有12例死亡,以65歲以上病例為多,病例分布以該國東北部呵叻、猜也蓬府為多。
VRDw7yoWnJO_6GWT8nG7vA.en: Thailand announced an outbreak linked to eating undercooked pork. From 7 January to 3 September, 149 cases with hearing impairment symptoms were reported, and 12 deaths have occurred to date. Cases are mostly among people aged 65 and over, and are concentrated in Nakhon Ratchasima and Chaiyaphum provinces in the northeast of the country.

JbW5N2XCumpQIBrbv9_a1g.zh: 泰國今年截至10/8累計報告2,926例病例,以45至64歲族群為多,其中29例死亡,多為農民。 印度喀拉拉邦今年截至10/4累計報告約4,500例病例,其中2,512例確診,確診病例中155例死亡(CFR:6.2%)。 捷克9/29報告今年首例病例,為東部摩拉維亞-西利西亞州64歲男性,於9月中旬遭遇洪災,直接暴露於受汙染水源。
JbW5N2XCumpQIBrbv9_a1g.en: Thailand has reported 2,926 cases cumulatively this year as of 8 October, mainly among people aged 45 to 64; 29 died, most of them farmers. India's Kerala state reported about 4,500 cases cumulatively this year as of 4 October, of which 2,512 were confirmed; 155 of the confirmed cases died (CFR: 6.2%). Czechia reported its first case of this year on 29 September: a man aged 64 from the Moravian-Silesian Region in the east, who was directly exposed to contaminated water after floods in mid-September.
